PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Benz. ac.]
Angina faucium and tonsillaris with characteristic high-colored, strong urine.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Benz. ac.]
White, stinking, liquid stools. θ Diarrhœa of children.
Diarrhœa of children, discharge copious, watery, clearcolored, very fetid ; profuse, watery, running through diaper ; urine uncommonly deep red, and urinous odor very strong.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Benz. ac.]
Urine dark, urinous odor highly intensified. θ Sore throats ; diarrhœa ; menstrual derangements ; hypochondriasis ; rheumatism ; nephritic colic ; after gonorrhœa ; gleet, or syphilis ; prolapsus uteri.
Renders urine acid ; hippuric acid.
A granular kind of mucus mixed with phosphate in sediment ; urine dark, reddish-brown ; acid reaction, or very offensive ; fleeting pains in bladder, not when urinating, but at other times. θ Vesical catarrh, from suppressed gonorrhœa, calculi, or gout.
Enuresis nocturna of children.
Urine highly colored, sometimes of color of French brandy, urinous odor exceedingly strong.
Dark, or highly colored, offensive urine, after suppressed syphilis or gonorrhœa.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Benz. ac.]
Prolapsus uteri with fetid urine.
   

COUGH. [27] [Benz. ac.]
Cough followed by expectoration of green mucus.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Benz. ac.]
Great weakness ; difficult breathing, increasing every hour.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Benz. ac.]
During night gout commences in right great toe ; his gout going from left to right.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Benz. ac.]
Gouty concretions.
   

NERVES. [36] [Benz. ac.]
Weariness, lassitude.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Benz. ac.]
Mucous states.
Gouty diathesis ; arthritis vaga.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Benz. ac.]
Useful after abuse of Copaiva in suppression of gonorrhœa ; or for warts around anus, appearing after Copaiva has been used for chancre.
